ephemeral.description: Required exact Sandbox A startup contract. Use the YAML strings "true" or "false"; YAML booleans and all other shapes are invalid.

transport.description: T-64: closed vocabulary matching the DSA sanitizer's declared-transport contract (services/sanitizer/config.py on the feat/gliner-remote-fallback branch). Empty string means 'derive from sanitizer.piiMlClient.endpoint' (deployment.yaml auto-declares in_box_plaintext only when endpoint is the stock in-cluster default; an overridden endpoint with this left empty fails the Helm render). A typo here (e.g. "tailnett") is caught at `helm template`/`lint` time instead of silently reaching the sanitizer as an unrecognized value.
